tasks.title: [TASK:S-001] Create the Terra smoke fixture
tasks.description: Create smoke/terra.txt as UTF-8 without BOM. Its bytes must be exactly TERRA_SMOKE_OK followed by one LF. Do not change any other tracked path and do not commit.

tasks.title: [TASK:S-002] Prove forced Terra-to-Sol takeover
tasks.description: For the Terra phase, create smoke/takeover.txt as UTF-8 without BOM containing exactly TERRA_INITIAL_OK followed by one LF. Do not change any other tracked path and do not commit. The harness will validate and may provide takeover instructions.
